name: Group Media Paragraphs tracker
description: Adds media used in paragraphs to corresponding group.
project_description:
This module is designed to associate group specific media elements with a group when using the Group module.

 Back to top 

 Groupmedia 1.0.x 
 Requirements:

 
 Group module greater than 1.0-rc3. 
 Media module (for 2.x - media in core, for 1.x - media_entity contrib module . 
 
 Module version 1.x is ONLY for media_entity contrib module 

 Back to top 

 Groupmedia 2.0.x 
 Requirements:

 
 Group module greater than 1.0-rc3. 
 Core Media module. 
 
 Back to top 

 Groupmedia 3.0.x 
 Use this version, if you want to migrate from Group 1.0.

 Requirements:

 
 Group module greater than 2.0. 
 Core Media module. 
 
 Back to top 

 Groupmedia 4.0.x 
 Use this version for new installations.

 Requirements:

 
 Group module greater than 3.0. 
 Core Media module. 
 
 Back to top 

 IMPORTANT! 
 

As per this comment media integration for Group module is moved completely to this module. The porting of the patch was done here Issue #3151858: Port gmedia patch into this module and define a migration path . For the upgrade path please read the documentation page . Upgrade is available since 8.x-2.0-alpha5 version.
